$comment: Census safety policy. Written by the main 2.0 session only (plan 6.1). Sources: docs/v2/PLAN.md sections 1.4 (target tiers), 4.3 (vocabularies), 5.3 (live-lane rules) and Appendix B (deny-list seed). Every list here is a seed; Appendix B says the lists are regenerated from census-verified labels at the Phase 4 exit and signed off by the owner.

dispositions.$comment: `deferred` is a non-terminal status on an active row, never a disposition (plan 1.4). `blocked`, `duplicate-of` and `subsumed-by` carry a reference part (`blocked:<probe id>`, `duplicate-of:<id>`, `subsumed-by:<id>`).

module.why: Definition of done 5: all 11 modules reachable live through wb_module or dispositioned blocked

window.why: UI container: readable means listable with its children

menu-item.why: UI action; needs a pass oracle

dialog.why: UI container; open-risk and commit-risk are split per row

control.why: UI action or state inside a container

property.why: Knowledge row: property field of a game class; operability lives on the parent container tool

property-editor.why: One of the 31 UIWidgets kinds; its popup is a child container

shortcut.why: Knowledge row; driven through the action it binds

tool.why: World Editor tool: dialog-free or worker-callable ones are driven; otherwise a disposition

canvas-gesture.why: Manual row: no label, slot, class or file trace (plan 4.6)

region.why: Opaque region; operations on it get their own rows

hazard-dialog.why: Catalogued as met; never answered automatically

class.why: Knowledge row for the Workbench API scope

method.why: Workbench API method: T5 or a disposition

static-method.why: Workbench API static: T5 or a disposition

event.why: Workbench API event: T5 or a disposition

attribute.why: [Attribute] member (E15): own shard, schema for the container tool

plugin.why: Dialog-free or worker-callable plugins are driven; otherwise re-implemented logic, CLI or GUI path; else a disposition. RunCommandline is never called live.

plugin-setting.why: Settings read and write through the plugin bridge; a live test promotes to T5

plugin-cli-arg.why: CLI switch of a plugin; T5 where safe

net-function.why: Native NET function: T5 or a disposition

net-handler.why: Bohemia handler: T5 or a disposition; modal handlers (BakeInfo, EBTInfo) are excluded

net-field.why: Request or response field: knowledge row

cli-switch.why: T5 where safe; publish and login switches excluded

file-type.why: Minimum for text formats; T5 writable only where a lossless writer and engine acceptance are proven; binary formats header read or not-automatable

setting-key.why: Readable; T4 writable only through a sandbox settings file; the registry is read-only by default (D4)

option.why: UI state: readable, drivable where settable

diag-menu.why: Knowledge row, own shard; T3/T4 where U34 finds a path

debug-panel.why: In-play debug panel; T3 or T4 where W8 finds a path

mcp-tool.why: The MCP's own surface: every tool action links to at least one row (G8) and has a live test

risk_overrides.$comment: A UI action, CLI switch or handler whose risk is destructive, credential or external has target T2 plus a disposition; it is documented, walked read-only, never committed by default (plan 1.4).

execute_action.$comment: ExecuteAction only with paths on this allow-list (plan 5.3). Entries are arrays of path segments, e.g. ["Window", "Resource Browser"]. The first battery is Window-menu dock toggles; entries are added per session queue by the main session and compiled into the probe handler (Appendix A). Never dictionary-probe.

deny_lists.$comment: Appendix B. Three lists because opening a dialog and committing it are different risks.

openers_main_never_invokes.$comment: The dialog behind each is still censused: the owner clicks the opener after an in-chat go, main reads the open dialog, the owner closes it with Cancel.

never_invoked_by_any_tool.$comment: A human commits. Credential fields are never typed into (plan 1.3).

local_destructive_confirmation_required.$comment: Never invoked during the census; by tools only with an explicit confirmation parameter.

dry_run.$comment: Every live script has a dry-run mode that fails if it would issue an invoke on a menu leaf, an Enter or accelerator key, or a deny-listed path (plan 6.2 BATTERY-AUTHOR). The only exceptions are named here.

target.windowClassMatches: probe dialog class recorded in DECISIONS.md after U6

exceptions.why: The modal test (U6) may post one Enter to a window whose class and title match its own probe dialog; the dry run asserts that target.
